Description
Evoking the charm of a modern fairy tale, this three-piece lehenga set seamlessly bridges traditional romance with editorial sophistication. The voluminous lehenga is constructed from premium tulle heavily adorned with translucent sequins, over which a watercolor floral canvas is digitally printed to create an iridescent, shimmering movement with every step. The choli is a masterclass in craft, featuring structured paneling, a classic sweetheart neckline, and a dense overlay of delicate hand-embroidery, zardozi, and micro-pearls. Product Details / Work
Lehenga Fabric: Premium micro-sequin net/tulle with an all-over digital floral print.

Blouse Fabric: Silk base with intricate hand-embroidery, cutwork elements, micro-pearl drops, and silver zardozi detailing.

Cape Fabric: Sheer net with soft thread embroidery and pearl-beaded tassel borders.

Closure: Concealed side zippers for both the lehenga and the blouse.

Silhouette Details
Lehenga: A-line maxi flare with an structured waistband and voluminous ruffled hem.

Blouse: Cropped, structured corset-style choli with a sweetheart neckline and pearl-drop hem.

Cape: High-neck, open-front trailing cape attached at the neckline with a delicate button closure.

Expert Fit And Advice
The Silhouette: This cut is exceptionally flattering for balancing proportions; the structured, high-waisted lehenga elongates the lower body, while the statement cape draws the eye upward and adds dramatic dimension without adding bulk.

Styling Tip: Keep the neck bare to honor the high-collar cape details. Opt for statement floral studs or delicate drop earrings in silver or pearl. Style your hair in a sleek high ponytail or a clean bun to let the cape’s back and collar detailing take center stage.

High-key obsessed. This three-piece ensemble is designed to turn heads and break the internet. The shirt is crafted from ultra-premium organza in a dreamy celadon green, absolutely dripping in intricate floral embroidery, cutwork detailing, and a heavily hand-embellished neckline that captures the light perfectly.

Neckline: Heavily hand-embellished with premium crystals, beads, and 3D threadwork.

Bottoms: Dramatic, high-waisted Dhaka pants that fit comfortably through the waist and hips before flowing out into a massive, floor-sweeping flare.

Expert Fit & Advice
Fit Tip: This outfit fits true to size with zero stretch in the organza shirt, so precise bust and waist measurements are key for that snatched look.

Styling Advice: Because the neckline is already heavily iced out with hand-embellished work, skip the heavy necklaces. Go for a pair of statement diamond or silver drop earrings, pull your hair back into a sleek high ponytail or a snatched half-updo to let the cutwork shoulders shine, and finish the look with your favorite metallic silver heels.

Exude timeless elegance in this masterfully crafted luxury ensemble. The outfit features a classic straight shirt in refreshing ombre shades of mint green hue to rose pink, meticulously adorned with vertical lines of shimmering self embroidery that elongate the frame. The highlight of the ensemble is a sheer organza jacket-style cape layered over the shirt, showcasing a stunning display of floral cutwork embroidery in soft lavender and rose-pink tones. Paired flawlessly with sleek, pastel pink bootcut pants finished with an embellished scallop border, this outfit strikes the perfect balance between traditional opulence and contemporary sophistication, making it an ideal choice for grand festive occasions.

Product Details / Work
Fabric: Organza (Cape), Self embroidered chiffon (Shirt), Raw Silk (Trousers).

Cape Work: Fully cutwork-embroidered organza jacket featuring delicate floral motifs, accented with hand-placed pearls, sequins, crystals, and fine stone work.

Shirt Work: Intricate self embroidery, heavily laden with micro-sequins running down to a scalloped, embellished hemline.

Trousers Work: Tailored bootcut pants featuring a delicate (lace) embellished scallop border along the hemline to match the shirt.

The Styling Guide: This outfit is designed to create a tall, slender illusion thanks to the vertical embroidery on the shirt and the elongating silhouette of the wide-leg bootcut trousers.

Fit Tip: Ensure the bootcut trousers are hemmed to perfectly graze the top of your shoes to maximize the leg-lengthening effect.

Jacket Artistry: Overlapping asymmetric design featuring extensive hand-embellishment, highlighted by a glittering, hand-stitched stone lace border running along the collar, placket, and hem.

Sleeves: Straight-cut organza sleeves adorned with fine floral threadwork embroidery, shimmering sequins, and a detailed hand-worked cuff border.

Skirt: Crafted from a rich, metallic-sheen silk blend, featuring a beautifully structured, asymmetrical pleated skirt silhouette.

Dupatta: A coordinating tie-and-dye choker-style dupatta adorned with hand-embellished accent lace and custom, handmade hanging tassels.

Silhouette Details
Jacket: Cropped, structured jacket with a crossover V-neckline silhouette that sits perfectly at the high waist.

Skirt: A high-waisted, asymmetrical pleated skirt that offers an elongated, column-like look with dynamic movement.

Expert Fit & Advice
Fit: The jacket offers a tailored, structured fit across the shoulders and bust, while the pre-styled pleated skirt hugs the waist cleanly before falling into a fluid, forgiving drape.

Styling Tip: Since the outfit features a beautiful cropped jacket and an accompanying choker dupatta, keep your neck bare and pull your hair into a sleek, center-parted low bun or ponytail as shown. Pair with champagne or metallic gold strappy heels and delicate diamond drop earrings to keep the focus on the intricate stone lace detailing.

7193715933219.title: The Gilded Ivory Trousseau
7193715933219.description:
Description: The Gilded Ivory Trousseau is a tribute to minimalist opulence. Crafted from a premium chikankaari embroidered fabric that catches the light with every movement, the shirt is detailed with hand-finished gold accents and traditional tassel detailing at the neckline. The architectural silhouette of the straight-cut tunic paired with high-volume trousers creates a look of effortless authority. Completed with a diaphanous zarri woven dupatta featuring metallic-striped borders, this set is designed for the woman who commands attention through subtlety and grace.

Color: Antique Cream / Champagne Gold (A rich, warm ivory base with metallic gold tilla work and champagne-hued embellishments.)

Product Details / Work:
* Fabric: Premium Chikankaari Embroidered Chiffon shirt and trousers with a Sheer * Zarri Woven dupatta.
* Workmanship: Fine Gold Tilla (metallic thread) embroidery along the hemlines, side slits, and sleeve cuffs.
* Neckline Detail: A structured keyhole neckline featuring hand-crafted metallic thread tassels and a gold-piped border.
* Dupatta: Lightweight zarri woven with horizontal gold-foil stripes and hand-tied tassels at the corners.
* Hemline: Finished with a delicate, shimmering gold-lace trim for a clean, luxury finish.

Profile Specification:

* Shirt: A classic Long Straight-Cut Tunic designed to provide a sleek, vertical frame.
* Sleeves: Full-length straight sleeves with a weighted embroidered border.
* Bottoms: Ultra-Wide Palazzo Trousers featuring a matching gold-work hem, providing a dramatic, floor-skimming movement.
* Fit: Structured at the bust and shoulders, flowing into a relaxed straight drape through the torso.

Designer Tips & Advice:

The Fit: This silhouette is designed to elongate. The monochromatic ivory palette creates a seamless line from head to toe, making it an excellent choice for a tall, editorial look.
Styling Tip: Follow the campaign's lead—style with a statement emerald choker and sleek-back hair for a "Modern Heritage" vibe. The addition of vintage-style optical frames adds a "Quirky Intellectual" edge to the high-fashion look.
Occasion: The ultimate choice for an intimate Nikah, a festive Eid lunch, or a luxury engagement party.
The Vibe: Monochromatic, Regal, and Architectural.
Daytime: Wear it with simple gold flats and a neutral oversized tote. Let the self-textured jacquard be the star without over-accessorizing.
Evening Transition: This is where the piece truly shines. Add the statement emerald choker (as seen in the campaign) or a deep ruby set for a pop of color. Switch to a sleek-back ponytail to emphasize the high-fashion, "Quirky Intellectual" frames.
Best For: Festive dinners, formal evening gatherings, or a minimalist bridal look.

7200040288291.title: The Gilded Prism Power Suit
7200040288291.description:
Description: Redefine evening-wear authority with the Gilded Prism Suit. Moving away from traditional drapes, this ensemble utilizes architectural tailoring to create a high-impact silhouette. The entire suit is a canvas of light, featuring a meticulous diamond-grid of reflective mirrors that catch the light from every angle. It’s a bold fusion of heritage craft and the grit of urban luxury, designed for the woman who wants to lead the room with a sharp, shimmering presence.

Color: Antique Champagne & Reflective Gold looking Sequins (A warm, sandy-beige base heavily encrusted with geometric gold foil mirror-looking work and metallic thread.)

Product Details / Work:
* Fabric: Heavyweight Premium Tulle base with a reinforced Silk-Satin lining for structure.
* Workmanship: All-over Geometric Mirror-Looking Work (Sequin) held by intricate gold tilla thread embroidery.
* Blazer Details: Classic notched lapel, single-button closure, and structured shoulder pads for a powerful frame.
* Texture: A high-definition ""Prism"" effect created by alternating the angles of the reflective foil mirrors.
* Bottoms: Dramatic Flare Trousers (Bell-bottoms) that fit slim through the thigh and kick out at the knee for a 70s-inspired high-fashion edge.
* Lines: Vertical geometric patterns are used to streamline the body, creating an illusion of height and a sharp, tailored finish.

Profile Specification:

Saree Style: Classic Nivi drape with a heavy fall.

Blouse Cut: Full-length sheer sleeves with a deep sweetheart neckline to accentuate the collarbone.

Fit: Tapered at the waist with a voluminous, flowing pallu that creates an elongated, statuesque frame.

Designer Tips & Advice:

The Fit: The blazer is designed for a tailored but slightly oversized look. If you prefer a cinched waist, we recommend pairing it with a thin metallic belt. The trousers feature a high-waisted fit to maximize the flared leg effect.

Styling Tip: Keep the inner layer simple—a nude silk camisole or nothing at all for a daring V-neckline. Style with sleek-back hair and gold hoop earrings to lean into the "Power Suit" aesthetic.

Occasion: The ultimate "After-Party" look, a high-end fashion gala, or a statement engagement ensemble for the non-traditional bride.

7208009039907.title: The Gilded Rose Front-Open Angrakha & Voluminous Ruffled Sharara
7208009039907.description:
Description: Exude timeless elegance in this masterfully crafted gold ensemble. The outfit features a long-line, front-open tunic (kameez) that is densely hand-worked with floral and geometric motifs. The standout feature is the lower half: a magnificent sharara featuring tiered, crushed ruffles that create incredible volume and movement. Designed for the modern bride or a high-profile festive event, this look balances the structured delicacy of the top with the architectural drama of the skirt.

Color: Antique Gold / Champagne Gold - The hue features a metallic sheen with warm, bronzed undertones, giving it a vintage yet radiant finish.

Product Details / Work:

Fabric: Tissue Silk for the shirt & for the ruffled sharara.

Embroidery: Tonal threadwork, micro-sequins, and delicate beadwork.

Technique: Intricate ""Jaal"" (net-like) embroidery patterns across the bodice and sleeves.

Hemline: Clean, straight edges on the shirt to contrast with the chaotic beauty of the ruffles below.

Profile Specification:

Neckline: Deep V-neckline with a sleek front-slit opening. 

Sleeves: Slim-fit, three-quarter length sleeves.

Bottom: Extra-flared "Farshi" style sharara with heavy gathering and ruffled borders to create a circular "pool" effect at the feet.

Fit: Fitted at the bust and waist, flowing into a structured A-line shirt.

Designer Tips & Advice:

Styling Tip: Since the outfit is monochromatic and high-shine, keep your jewelry classic. A kundan or polki choker with emerald drops would provide a beautiful pop of color against the gold.

Footwear: Wear high heels (4-5 inches) to ensure the ruffles drape perfectly and don't trip you up.

Hair & Makeup: A sleek bob or a tight low bun (as pictured) keeps the focus on the heavy neckline. Opt for "bronzed goddess" makeup with a nude lip.

Alterations: Ensure the front slit starts at a height that allows for comfortable walking while maintaining the modest silhouette of the shirt.

7231253086243.title: The Ivory Regalia
7231253086243.description:
Exact Colour: Classic Ivory / Off-White with Rich Gold and Champagne Accents

Description
Step into a world of timeless royalty with our Ivory Regalia ensemble. The focal point of this outfit is a stunningly tailored, flared long kameez crafted from a premium self-sequined fabric. It features intricate, reflective mirror-like embroidery dancing across the front bodice, neckline, and hemline, catching the light beautifully with every movement.

Designed with statement high front slits starting from the waist, the kameez splits gracefully to unveil a magnificent pair of crushed Banarasi fabric dhaka pants underneath. The dhaka pants offer an incredible volume, accented with gold gota horizontal borders along the lower tier. Complete with a rich, coordinating ivory dupatta featuring heavy woven Banarasi patterns and embroidered gold borders, this look is an absolute dream for Nikkah ceremonies, Eid, or festive family occasions.

Product Details / Work
Kameez Fabric: Premium self-woven sequined fabric with a soft, lightweight drape and comfortable lining.

Artistry / Embroidery: Heavy mirror-like embroidery (sheesha or high-shine reflective foil work) mixed with metallic gold tilla threadwork along the neckline, center bodice, and hemline.

Front Slits: Dual front-open slits starting from the high waist to add a contemporary, fluid movement to the flared kameez.

Dhaka Pants: Crafted from authentic, rich Banarasi silk-blend fabric, heavily crushed for modern texture, and finished with layered gold gota ribbon details on the hem.

Dupatta: Lightweight coordinating ivory dupatta featuring woven gold Banarasi motifs scattered throughout and heavily embroidered borders.

Silhouette Details
Kameez: An elegant, flared A-line long silhouette with structured shoulders, full-length sleeves, a round neckline, and dramatic front-panel slits.

Bottoms: Traditional dhaka pants ultra-flared, heavily gathered and crushed lower tiers.

Expert Fit & Advice
Fit: Fitted snugly through the shoulders, bust, and waist, cascading into a sweeping, voluminous lower half. The front slits allow for effortless walking and movement despite the heavy flare.

Styling Tip: To complement the rich ivory and gold palette, pair this ensemble with a classic polki or pearl choker necklace and matching statement jhumkas. Keep your hair down in a sleek, middle-parted straight style to let the embroidered back and neckline frame you beautifully. Style with metallic gold block heels or traditional embellished khussas.

7212698730531.title: The Jardin Mint (RTW 2PC)
7212698730531.description:
Embrace the art of high-end lounging with the Jardin Mint Ensemble. This two-piece set is a celebration of botanical beauty, blending a serene seafoam palette with a maximalist clashing of lush greenery and delicate peonies. The tunic is elevated by heavy cream embroidery that frames the neckline and climbs the sleeves, while the wide-leg palazzos offer a fluid, graceful movement. It’s a piece that feels as light as air but looks like a curated masterpiece—perfect for the woman who finds her inspiration in the hidden gardens of Europe.

"Fabric: Luxury Egyptian Lawn with a high-thread-count silk finish.

Embroidery: Signature cream silk-thread work on the neckline and sleeve panels.

Lace Work: Elaborate Cut-work lace overlays and laser-cut scalloped borders on the tunic hem, sleeves, and trouser cuffs.

Print: High-definition digital print featuring a mix of tropical palm motifs and classical English roses.

Neckline: A sophisticated V-neckline with an ornate, hand-worked lace-style frame."

7212698763299.title: The Lilac Chateau (RTW 2PC)
7212698763299.description:
Evoke the romance of a countryside estate with the Lilac Chateau set. This ensemble is a celebration of spring, featuring a fluid wisteria-hued base adorned with a maximalist clash of Renaissance-style florals. The tunic is elevated by high-contrast cream embroidery at the neckline and hem, while the matching wide-leg trousers ensure a seamless, elongated silhouette. Designed for the woman who seeks the comfort of luxury lawn with the prestige of an editorial runway piece.

"Fabric: Premium Egyptian Lawn with a soft, silk-finish handfeel.

Workmanship: Intricate crafted lace appliqués on the sleeves, shirt hem, and trouser cuffs.

Neckline: A structured V-neckline featuring tonal cream silk-thread embroidery and delicate pearl finishing.

Print Technique: High-fidelity digital print with ""trompe l'oeil"" lace effects integrated into the floral pattern."

7230377328675.title: The Lilac Mist
7230377328675.description:
Exact Colour: Soft Rose Pink / Pale Lilac with an Ice Blue Ombré Dupatta

Description
Radiate effortless femininity with our Lilac Mist ensemble, designed to bring a soft, luminous charm to your festive wardrobe. The long shirt is beautifully rendered in sheer, premium organza that is fully adorned with intricate, pastel-toned embroidery and cutwork. Layered over a fully sequined fabric lining and soft silk underlay, the outfit boasts a subtle, captivating sparkle with every turn.

A high center-front slit starts at the waist, perfectly showcasing the dramatic texture of the matching crushed, flared dhaka pants beneath. The look is elevated by a dreamy ombré dyed dupatta that seamlessly transitions from soft ice blue to delicate lilac, beautifully finished with heavy sequined fabric panels on the pallu for a grand, traditional statement.

Product Details / Work
Shirt Fabric: Premium sheer Organza overlay with a fully sequined fabric underlay and smooth silk lining for a comfortable, glowing finish.

Shirt Artistry: Intricate all-over floral and geometric threadwork embroidery and cutwork, highlighted by statement damask-style motifs flanking the lower hemline.

Front Detail: A formal central placket adorned with matching fabric-trimmed loop buttons, leading down to a dramatic high front-open slit.

Bottoms: Voluminous, flared dhaka pants featuring a distinct tier of tightly crushed metallic-sheen fabric that catches the light beautifully as you walk.

Dupatta: Multi-toned ombré dyed sheer dupatta with delicate lace borders, anchored by heavy, fully sequined fabric panels on both pallus.

Silhouette Details
Shirt: An elegant, straight, long-line shirt with a wide scoop neckline and a bold front slit that breaks up the length.

Bottoms: Traditional dhaka pants opening into a wide, heavily flared, crushed tier at the bottom.

Expert Fit & Advice
Fit: Designed to fit tailored and snug through the shoulders and torso, while the front slit and flared dhaka pants provide maximum freedom, movement, and a stunning floaty drape.

Styling Tip: Embrace the breezy, romantic aesthetic by opting for soft, bouncy curls or effortless waves. Keep the jewelry delicate with a thin silver diamond necklace and matching drop earrings. Finish the look with heavily embellished traditional khussas or metallic silver block heels to complement the crushed fabric texture.

7185323458595.title: The Mauve Glitz
7185323458595.description:
Description: Designed for the modern festive wardrobe, this outfit features a translucent organza shirt layered over a sequin lining. The embroidery is a mix of vertical geometric lines and intricate floral vine patterns, finished with delicate pearl droplets on the sleeves and hem for a touch of movement.

Color: Dusky Mauve

Product Details / Work:
All-over silver embroidery with pearls, hand-beaded pearl tassels on sleeves and shirt hem, paired with raw silk straight trousers.

Profile Specification:

Relaxed straight-fit mid-length shirt with full sleeves and tailored straight-leg trousers with pearl-beaded cuffs.

Designer Tips & Advice:

A very versatile fit that suits most body types. The vertical embroidery lines create an elongating effect. Pair with silver strappy heels and minimal "dewy" makeup to complement the cool tones.

7251736952867.title: The Mauve Magic Dhaka Set
7251736952867.description:
Exact Colour
Frosted Mauve & Silver Mist (A stunning, muted lilac-mauve tone with cool, metallic silver embroidery accents).

Description
We are officially obsessed, this three-piece masterpiece is made for everyone looking to serve pure elegance with an edge. The shirt is crafted from premium Chanderi fabric, beautifully detailed with classic Chikankari-inspired threadwork, glittering mirror-like embroidery, and brilliant Zari work that adds just the right amount of sparkle.

The silhouette stays iconic with flowing raw silk Dhaka pants that boast a gorgeous embroidered hemline for that effortless sway. Paired with a lightweight, floating chiffon dupatta covered in delicate scatter details and heavy lace borders, it’s giving ethereal, it’s giving luxury, and it’s a total mood.

Product Details / Work
Shirt: Premium Chanderi fabric adorned with intricate Chikankari thread embroidery.

Embellishments: Mirror-like reflective embroidery and detailed metallic Zari work woven throughout the front panels and borders.

Pants: Flowing raw silk Dhaka pants featuring a heavily embroidered and scalloped bottom hemline.

Dupatta: Sheer chiffon dupatta with all-over delicate sequin/mirror sprays and an oversized, statement border.

Silhouette Details
Top: A classic long, straight-cut tunic with long sleeves, featuring an intricate scalloped neckline and hem for a beautifully structured fit.

Bottoms: Dramatic, wide-flare Dhaka pants that create stunning volume and movement from the knee down.

Expert Fit & Advice
Fit Tip: The Chanderi shirt offers a tailored, structured fit through the shoulders and torso with no stretch, so stick to your true size for that perfectly snatched look.

Styling Advice: Since the outfit is packed with intricate Zari and mirror-like details, keep your jewelry sleek. Style it with minimal silver studs or delicate drop earrings, pull your hair back into a low, effortless bun, and let the statement chiffon dupatta do all the talking. Pair with strappy silver heels to complete the fit.

Model size Small
Shirt length 40 inches
Dhaka Pant length 41.5 inches

7254298984483.title: The Midnight Eclipse Fusion Lehenga Saree
7254298984483.description:
Exact Colour
Midnight Cosmic Blue & Pastel Pop (A deep, rich metallic indigo-navy that’s heavily iced out in sequins, layered with an ethereal sheer overlay featuring soft blush-pink and silver embroidery).

Description
This ensemble completely redefines traditional luxury by layering a glittering, night-sky inspired midnight blue lehenga-saree with a high-fashion sheer long jacket. The cropped blouse is completely iced out in shimmering sequins with delicate crystal droplet fringe details along the hem to keep it playful.

The drape cascades effortlessly, catching the light from every single angle. To elevate the drama to a 10/10, the look is layered with an intricately embroidered and hand embellished sheer jacket covered in pastel floral threadwork, metallic borders, and full-length embellished sleeves. It’s giving royalty meets runway, it's giving effortless glamour, and it's bound to break the internet.

Product Details / Work
Blouse/Crop Top: Strapless-style square neck cropped blouse, densely embellished with premium sequins and finished with a hanging crystal-bead fringe.

Lehenga-Saree Drape: Pre-draped saree style over a flared lehenga skirt, crafted in high-shine sequinned fabric with a beautifully finished silver-piped border.

Jacket: Full-length, open-front sheer net jacket featuring vertical silver tilla embroidery, hand embellishment, soft pastel-pink floral threadwork, and an elegant patterned collar.

Silhouette Details
Top & Bottom: A structured, body-hugging crop top paired with a high-waisted, mermaid-to-flare lehenga silhouette that instantly creates a snatched waistline and flows into a dramatic floor pool.

Layering: A sharp, long-line straight jacket that perfectly frames the torso while adding gorgeous movement and length.

Expert Fit & Advice
Fit Tip: Since the crop top and the pre-draped waist are highly structured to give you that perfect contour, accurate bust and upper-waist measurements are an absolute must.

Styling Advice: Keep the neck bare to highlight the clean lines of the square-neck blouse and the jacket's collar. Go for high-shine silver statement earrings, a sleek middle-part with soft Hollywood waves, and metallic strappy stilettos to match the silver detailing of the dress.

7230534582307.title: The Mint Blossom Lehenga Set
7230534582307.description:
Description: Exude timeless elegance in this Sage Green Organza Lehenga Set. Designed for the woman who loves a mix of heritage and modern flair, this ensemble features a meticulously hand-embellished choli with delicate beadwork and a scalloped pearl fringe. The high-waisted lehenga skirt is crafted from premium organza, showcasing a romantic gradient of oversized peony and rose prints. Complemented by a sheer, embroidered dupatta, this set is a masterpiece of soft textures and ethereal movement, making it an ideal choice for weddings, receptions, or grand celebrations.

Color: Sage Green with Peony Pink and Cornflower Blue Florals

Product Details / Work:
Choli: Sleeveless V-neck blouse with heavy tonal embroidery, sequins, and crystal beadwork. Finished with a decorative pearl-drop fringe at the hem.

Lehenga: High-waisted, pleated organza skirt featuring digital floral prints in shades of pink, purple, and blue. The hem is finished with a subtle geometric border.

Dupatta: Lightweight sage green Net dupatta with delicate floral-lace borders and scattered sequin spray.

Fabric: Premium Sheesha Silk (Skirt), Silk Blend (Choli Lining), Net (Dupatta)

Profile Specification:

Top: Fitted, cropped sleeveless choli with a deep V-neckline.

Bottom: Full-circle A-line lehenga with heavy pleating at the waist to create maximum volume and a "twirl-worthy" flare.

Waist: Fixed waistband with a side zip closure for a seamless fit.

Designer Tips & Advice:

Style Note: This pastel palette works beautifully for daytime outdoor events or sunset ceremonies.

Jewellery: Pair with a delicate choker and teardrop earrings (as shown) to keep the focus on the intricate neckline.

Footwear: Since the lehenga is floor-length, opt for high-heeled mojaris or embellished block heels to maintain the silhouette's height and grace.

Fit Tip: Ensure the choli is snugly fitted at the bust to balance the extreme volume of the floral skirt.

7037291626531.title: The Mint Sage Longline Kurta & Overlay Set
7037291626531.description:
Exact Colour: Mint Sage Green with delicate pastel pink and silver-toned thread embroidery.

Description
Exude timeless elegance in an ensemble that celebrates structure, symmetry, and soft pastel artistry. This premium three-piece set is designed with a modern column silhouette that instantly elongates the frame.

The highlight of the outfit is the structured, floor-length sheer overlay. It is heavily decorated with vertical embroidery panels that seamlessly blend intricate geometric latticework with soft, blooming pink floral motifs. A delicate crystal or pearl bead fringe trims the sleeve cuffs and lower hemline, adding a subtle touch of movement. Layered over a solid silk inner lining and structured slim-leg trousers, this look is an impeccable choice for daytime luxury events, high teas, and festive celebrations.

Product Details / Work
Overlay/Kurta Fabric: Premium sheer net 

Inner & Trouser Fabric: High-quality blended raw silk or satin silk for a sleek finish.

Embroidery/Work: Intricate vertical panel threadwork featuring pastel pink floral clusters, leafy vines, and delicate silver-toned geometric accents. The sleeve cuffs and front hem are finished with a delicate hanging pearl/bead fringe trim.

Component Count: 3-Piece Set (Embroidered Longline Overlay, Silk Inner Slip, Matching Slim Trousers).

Silhouette Details
Overlay: Straight, column-cut floor-length kurta with a high crew neckline, a subtle center-front split, and full-length tailored sleeves.

Inner: A matching sleeveless, full-length inner slip providing seamless coverage.

Trousers: Tailored, straight-fit trousers that maintain a clean, crisp line at the ankles.

Expert Fit and Advice
Fit: Tailored, straight-cut fit. Runs true to size and beautifully creates a taller, more slender appearance due to the strong vertical design lines.

Styling Tip: To complement the soft pink accents in the embroidery, style this outfit with a multi-layered pastel pink bead or pearl choker necklace (as seen in image_8be5de.jpg). Keep the hair in a sleek half-up, half-down style to draw attention to the high neckline.

Care Instructions: Dry clean only. Take care around sharp jewelry to protect the fine, embroidered vertical panels.

7222007529507.title: The Mint Whisper
7222007529507.description:
Exact Colour: Light Mint Green / Pale Sage

This exquisite set offers a sophisticated fusion of traditional craftsmanship and modern design. Crafted from luxurious fabrics in a serene pale mint hue, it consists of three key pieces. The foundation is a full-length, voluminous satin-silk saree pleated skirt that flows with graceful movement. Paired with it is a matching jacquard crop top meticulously adorned with intricate geometric and floral zari embroidery. The outfit is completed by a lightweight, open-front jacket made of chiffon fabric, featuring elaborate zari embroidery throughout, elegant scalloped edges along the front placket, and statement-making large bell sleeves with intricate detailing and delicate droplet tassels on the cuffs. This ensemble is ideal for formal functions, festive occasions, or a sophisticated bridesmaid look.

7208017788963.description:
Lilac Embroidered Elegance Suit

The Lilac Embroidered Elegance Suit is a masterpiece of traditional craftsmanship blended with contemporary elegance. The kurta showcases dense floral embroidery, cutwork, embellishment and sequin work on a light lilac chanderi fabric, creating a luxurious texture that catches the eye. The shawl collar and full-length sleeves are finished with delicate embroidery, cutwork and embellishment, adding a sophisticated touch. Paired with smooth lilac shalwar that have embroidery detailing at the hem, the outfit is completed with a sheer two toned lilac chiffon dupatta adorned with heavy cutwork and Embroidery on all four sides, giving a graceful flow. Ideal for formal gatherings or festive soirées, this suit exudes regal poise and timeless charm.

Product Details / Work
- Fabric:Chanderi and chiffon.
- Workmanship: Full-front cutwork plus embroidery with Banarsi gold tilla thread, sequins, pearls, stones and intricate lace detailing on all over shirt ; two toned dupatta features heavy embroidered borders with cutwork scallops.
- Texture: Soft, breathable and airy with luxurious embroidered surface giving a shimmering effect.

7212698664995.title: Urban Blossom (RTW 2PC)
7212698664995.description:
Elevate your everyday luxury with a piece designed for the modern woman on the move. Crafted from premium, breathable fabric, this two-piece set features a long-line tunic adorned with delicate botanical threadwork that climbs gracefully from the hem to the neckline. The muted mauve palette offers a sophisticated alternative to traditional brights, making it a versatile staple for high-end brunch dates or gallery openings. The juxtaposition of heritage embroidery against a gritty New York-style backdrop highlights the versatility of this collection, proving that tradition has a permanent place in the urban landscape.

"Fabric: Premium Matte Silk-Blend / High-Grade Cotton Lawn (depending on your specific production).

Embroidery: Multi-layered floral threadwork with meticulous cutwork detailing on the sleeves and hemline.

Neckline: Scalloped V-neck with tonal embroidery.

Sleeves: Slightly flared bell sleeves with intricate lace-insert panels and floral borders.

Back: Clean, minimalist finish with a concealed zip closure for a streamlined fit."

7130175733795.title: Velmique Heritage Maxi
7130175733795.description: Experience the allure of soft romance with our exquisite maxi dress. Meticulously crafted from luminous net, this timeless piece is a true work of art. Adorned with glistening cut dana, pearls, and tassels, every detail exudes luxury and sophistication. The intricate 3D butterfly motif adds a touch of whimsical charm, making this dress a true statement piece that echoes couture legacy.

7334396788771.title: Venus
7334396788771.description:
Colour
Pale dusty mauve net shirt with silver-toned embellishments, a metallic mauve-taupe skirt and a soft lilac-mauve dupatta.

Venus features a long, front-open net shirt with a V-neckline and embellished shoulder cutouts. Pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads trace fan-shaped motifs across the bodice and elongated patterns down the sheer sleeves and shirt panels. Open side chaaks reveal the pleated skirt beneath, while fine beaded fringe finishes the cuffs and daman.

The metallic mauve-taupe shimmer skirt falls in fine pleats to a wide scalloped border embellished with pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads. A sheer lilac-mauve net dupatta completes the three-piece ensemble, with scattered floral motifs and a glistening border detailed in the same beadwork.

Details:
Model size Small
Shirt Length 49 inches
Skirt Length 46.5 inches

7123181961251.title: Violet Opulence
7123181961251.description:
Organza Embroidered Jacket With Crushed Trouser

Description
Step into a world of refined opulence with Violet Opulence, an exquisite organza embroidered jacket designed in a captivating jewel-toned hue. Intricately embellished with shimmering sequins, delicate cut dana, and graceful tassel details, the jacket showcases elaborate patterns and artisanal craftsmanship that elevate its regal silhouette.

Paired with fluid chiffon crushed trousers, the ensemble creates a beautiful balance of texture, movement, and sophistication. A seamless fusion of heritage-inspired artistry and modern demi-couture elegance, Violet Opulence is designed to make an unforgettable statement at festive celebrations and special occasions.

7334363824163.title: Water Lilies
7334363824163.description:
Colour
Cool lavender-lilac shirt and dupatta with silver embellishments, paired with a double-shaded jamawar skirt in ice aqua and pale seafoam green.

Water Lilies features a long Sheesha silk shirt in cool lavender-lilac. Crystals frame the keyhole and shoulder cutouts, while pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads trace vertical patterns and floral motifs across the shirt. Delicate lattice cutwork opens up the fitted sleeves and scalloped daman, and pastel bead drops accent the waist.

The flared jamawar skirt blends ice aqua and pale seafoam green, with silver woven motifs that catch the light as the fabric moves. A matching lavender-lilac Sheesha silk dupatta completes the three-piece ensemble, with diagonal rows of embellishment and scalloped borders detailed with pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads.

Details:
Model size Small
Shirt length 52 inches
Skirt length 45 inches

7326201806883.title: Wisteria Mist (RTW)
7326201806883.description:
Colour — Soft Lilac & Icy Mint

Wisteria Mist pairs a soft lilac base with icy mint floral embroidery and scattered sequins that catch the light as you move. The sheer pallu is framed by a scalloped mint border, while long lilac fringe follows the sweep of the drape.

The matching halter blouse features sweeping rows of beadwork, pearl-like drops along the scalloped collar, and teardrop beads at the hem. At the back, embroidered straps frame the open silhouette, and a lace-up closure ends in long embellished tassels.

Details: 
Model size Small
Blouse length 13 inches
Saree length 42 inches

7222783901731.title: Wisteria Whispers (RTW 3PC)
7222783901731.description:
Embrace the breathability of premium Egyptian Lawn with an ensemble that bridges the gap between traditional craftsmanship and contemporary chic. The "Wisteria Whispers" set is defined by its ethereal lilac hue, serving as a serene canvas for the sprawling, monochromatic embroidery that adorns the front and sleeves. The delicate cutwork adds a layer of architectural depth, while the playful tassel fringe on the hemline and cuffs introduces a movement that is both whimsical and sophisticated. Paired with trouser featuring matching lace-effect borders & Chiffon dupatta. This outfit is an effortless choice for high-end summer soirées or editorial-ready daytime events.

Product Details / Work:
Fabric: 100% Premium Egyptian Lawn (Shirt & Trousers) Chiffon (Dupatta)
Embroidery: Dense ivory threadwork in floral and geometric motifs.

Silhouette Details:
Shirt: A structured, straight-cut tunic with a slight flare. Features a unique inverted "V" scalloped hemline to elongate the frame.
Sleeves: Full-length straight sleeves with sheer cutwork panels.
Trousers: Contemporary wide-leg silhouette with a clean front and detailed lace-style embroidery at the hem.

Expert Fit and Advice:
The Fit: This ensemble offers a "Relaxed Tailored" fit. It is designed to skim the body without being restrictive, ensuring the Egyptian Lawn remains breathable in humid climates.

Styling Tip: To maintain the editorial aesthetic, pair this with cream juttis or white leather flats and minimal diamond or silver stud earrings.

Occasion: Perfect for festive brunches, seaside gatherings, or upscale garden parties.

Care: Dry clean only to preserve the delicate tassel work and the integrity of the cutwork embroidery.

7164453584931.title: Zamurd
7164453584931.description:
Net Embroidered Blouse & Lehenga with Dupatta


Zamurd is a statement ensemble crafted on rich net fabric, featuring a heavily embroidered blouse and voluminous lehenga adorned with intricate silver-white detailing. The blouse is designed with delicate embellishment and graceful fringe accents, while the lehenga showcases ornate floral and traditional motifs for a grand, royal appeal. Paired with a matching net dupatta finished with embroidered borders, this outfit is perfect for weddings, formal occasions, and festive celebrations.

7311621226531.title: Zar Noor
7311621226531.description:
Colour: Soft Champagne with blush pink, muted sage and slate grey printed accents, finished with silver and pale gold embellishments

Zar Noor brings together soft champagne tones, delicate colour accents and intricate embellishment in an elegant three-piece ensemble. Accessories: Accentuate the warm tones of the print by pairing it with a statement headband (as pictured) or delicate gold jewelry. Keep the neck clean to let the detailed button-down placket shine.
